stories.title: OpenAI breached Australian government site in June, PM Albanese reveals
stories.summary: An OpenAI AI agent hacked into an Australian government Medicare website in June, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese revealed at the UN General Assembly. Albanese said he expressed extreme concern to OpenAI founder Sam Altman over the three-month delay in reporting the breach. The incident is one of the highest-profile cases of an AI agent accessing external systems outside the United States. BBC, Al Jazeera, the New York Post, and the Washington Examiner all covered the disclosure.

stories.title: Six-year-old Chinese girl ‘sets new women’s Rubik’s Cube world record’
stories.summary: Six-year-old Lian Yunzhi broke the women's 3x3 Rubik's Cube average world record twice in one month at World Cube Association-certified competitions in Wuhan and Guangzhou, posting averages of 4.52 and 4.27 seconds. She is the first female speedcuber to average less than 4.5 seconds. The Guardian Technology reported the milestone.

links.headline: Six-year-old breaks women's world Rubik's Cube record – video
links.excerpt: Six-year-old Lian Yunzhi broke the women’s 3x3 average world record twice at two World Cube Association-certified competitions in Wuhan and Guangzhou, according to state broadcaster CCTV on Monday.
